trigger: P2 alone passed R23A v0.3; R23B not authorized.
objective: Determine whether P2 represents genuine pre-20:00 reversion consumption by testing post-20:00 continuous trajectories, rather than only discrete R20 route labels.

universe.reason: P2 score and cross-price coordinate available

path_data.source: official daily kline archives referenced by R18 source ledger; event day plus next calendar day
path_data.integrity: record URL, SHA-256, rows and continuity; stop on missing interval

primary_tests.gate: negative direction in at least four evaluable years and calendar-block bootstrap CI below zero

primary_tests.outcome: cause-specific first passage to counter_excursion_fraction >= 0.25 by 12h
primary_tests.expected: one-SD higher P2_score reduces counter-passage hazard
primary_tests.model: one-parameter Cox model stratified by year; calendar-month clustered bootstrap
primary_tests.gate: hazard ratio < 1 in at least four evaluable years and pooled 95% bootstrap CI below 1

secondary_outputs: first passage to fixed fractions 0.10, 0.50 and 1.00 with Holm correction
maximum counter and aligned excursions at H1/H3/H6/H12
stopping_rules: Stop if any event path is discontinuous or cannot be joined exactly.
Do not alter P2 or the 0.25 primary barrier after reading results.
If T1 and T2 both fail, downgrade P2 to a route association and close this mechanism family.
If at least one primary test passes but the other fails, retain P2 as partial and do not build R23B.
Only if both primary tests pass may a P2 transition state be included in a future multiprocess model.
